claims.text: Con la ficha, todo lo que cuesta pavos es gratis 14 días (skins, gestos, mochilas, picos, instrumentos, autos, planeadores, canciones)
match: When you activate a token, every single item in the Fortnite Shop which costs V-Bucks becomes entirely free for the next 14 days
Everything else – skins, emotes, backpacks, pickaxes, instruments, cars, gliders, jam tracks – is entirely free for you to claim, as if you were buying it with V-Bucks

claims.text: Excepciones: niveles del pase de batalla, lotes con dinero real, regalar objetos, solo un compañero gratis
match: you can't claim Battle Pass levels, you can't get bundles that cost real money (instead of V-Bucks), you can't gift items to other players, and you can only claim one free sidekick
